command: cd /home/agent/workspace && sha256sum release/artifact.txt | awk '{print $1}' > release/digest.txt && DIGEST=$(cat release/digest.txt) && printf '{"1.0.0": "%s"}\n' "$DIGEST" > release/mapping.json && echo "digest: $(cat release/digest.txt)" && echo "mapping: $(cat release/mapping.json)"
intent: Recompute digest and update mapping for modified artifact
